variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman points the player to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends him to drive Red Corwin's bandits from the watchtower on Crow Hill for passage through the north gate.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Don't lose heart now, stranger, Halvard in the Moot Hall still means to see Corwin beaten!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text: Ohhh, it gets worse by the day! Not one of the guards I sent up Crow Hill has come back whole. I have nobody else. You must get up there and drive Red Corwin's bandits out of the old watchtower, quickly, before more travelers are carried off! Clear that hill, and the north gate opens for you.

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: What keeps you? Each day Corwin holds that tower, another cart is robbed on the north road! Go!

journal.text: Drive Red Corwin's bandits out of the watchtower on Crow Hill.

variants.specifics: Druvak: Dalmor points the player to Foreman Odrik in the Ore Hall, who sends him through the Deep Gate after Skarn; Yorvan sent the player.

herald.speaker: Dalmor
herald.text: Go see Foreman Odrik in the Ore Hall, then find that Skarn and knock his block off!

opening.speaker: Odrik
opening.text:
Thank goodness, Yorvan sent you, Wanderer! Skarn's Trolls have sealed the Deep Gate, and the miners I sent down to spy on that mad Conjurer are trapped below, or worse!

Take this key and open the Gate. Bring Skarn to justice in the Sunken Hall and every miner in Druvak will be in your debt!

reminder.speaker: Odrik
reminder.text: Keep whatever you take off those Trolls! But hurry, Skarn won't wait for you!

journal.text:
Open the Deep Gate and stop Skarn before the Trolls overrun Druvak.

The mad Conjurer is likely holed up in the Sunken Hall.

variants.specifics: Okkum: Pella points the player to Ysmay, Gorvald's old friend, who sends him past the Black Reeds after Ghessa the Bog Witch.

herald.speaker: Pella
herald.text: I was told to send outsiders straight up to Ysmay.

opening.speaker: Ysmay
opening.text:
Ghessa has turned our own drowned dead against us! Half of Okkum is packing up to leave! And she caught Bodrick out in the reeds and froze him stiff with a spell -- he hasn't moved a finger since!

Please, help us, kind sir! Gorvald swore you would come. I think her lair is the sunken shrine past the Black Reeds.

Would you... could you go out there and stop her?

reminder.speaker: Ysmay
reminder.text: Hurry, please! Every night more of the dead climb out of the mud!

journal.text: Cross the Black Reeds and find Ghessa the Bog Witch.

variants.specifics: Thrane: A townsman sends the player to Lord Ostric in the Great Hall, who sends him after Gruthak's Trolls on Gallow Hill and his son Dalric.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: The Trolls on Gallow Hill are a stinking, thieving rabble! Only Lord Ostric in the Great Hall has the stomach to stand up to them!

opening.speaker: Lord Ostric
opening.text:
You must be Fennick's friend! Thank goodness you've come! Gruthak's Trolls swarmed over Gallow Hill and took the old Beacon, and with it the only road north! My son Dalric was on watch up there when it fell!

Drive the brutes off that hill and bring my boy home, and Thrane will reward you well!

reminder.speaker: Lord Ostric
reminder.text: What, still here? Dalric could be in a Troll's stewpot by now!

journal.text: Bring Lord Ostric proof that the Trolls are gone from the Beacon.

variants.specifics: Skellow: Nubb points the player to Mayor Oskelt in the Town Hall, who sends him to drive Hulvo from the lighthouse on Gannet Rock and bring back Tamsin the ferrywoman.

herald.speaker: Nubb
herald.text: I'm sure I saw Hulvo's sail off Gannet Rock this morning. Better see Mayor Oskelt in the Town Hall!

opening.speaker: Mayor Oskelt
opening.text:
Oh, blast it! Hulvo again?! Sometimes I think that pirate wakes up just to ruin us. It's no easy thing keeping a village fed, I'll tell you. His raiders hold the lighthouse on Gannet Rock, they've taken the ferry and old Tamsin with it, and not one boat dares leave the harbor! And with the causeway under water, the only way out there is through the Leech marsh.

Listen... Get out to Gannet Rock, drive Hulvo out of that lighthouse and bring Tamsin home. Do that and Skellow will open its treasury to you! Talboth said you were the one for it!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Oskelt
reminder.text: Off with you! Off! Um... Mind the Leeches.

journal.text:
Drive Hulvo from the lighthouse on Gannet Rock and rescue Tamsin the ferrywoman.

(Hint: The causeway is flooded.)

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Krumm points the player to Archmage Dorvanis, barred in the Chapter House, who hands over the Observatory key and sends him after Vorlath.

herald.speaker: Krumm
herald.text: We must get help to Archmage Dorvanis in the Chapter House and drive these Golems out of our College!

opening.speaker: Dorvanis
opening.text: Yarrick's friend? Thank goodness! Vorlath's Golems are loose in the courts and I've had to bar myself in. Here, I'll push the Observatory key under the door. Stop Vorlath before he wakes every Golem we own!

reminder.speaker: Dorvanis
reminder.text: Every Golem he wakes is another one at my door. Off you go!

journal.text: Enter the Observatory and stop Vorlath.

variants.specifics: Fort Krell: Fenn points the player to Commander Hadrik in the keep, who sends him to throw Ghrulg's Trolls off the High Gate.

herald.speaker: Fenn
herald.text: Not me, sorry. Commander Hadrik is up in the keep.

opening.speaker: Hadrik
opening.text:
Hmph! Brannoc sent just one?! Well, it'll have to do. Ghrulg and his Trolls have taken the High Gate and shut the pass. Nobody gets north while they hold it. And Brannoc himself rides in before the week is out!

Get up there and throw them off the gate, and I'll pay you whatever the fort can spare.

Take this iron key. It opens the little door at the foot of the wall.

reminder.speaker: Hadrik
reminder.text: Trolls are big, but they're dim. Come back when the High Gate is ours.

journal.text: Drive Ghrulg and his Trolls off the High Gate.

variants.specifics: Varnok: Pell points the player to Forgemaster Dravic in the Guildhall, who sends him up Slag Ridge against Gorlak.

herald.speaker: Pell
herald.text: I'm wanted at the furnace, sorry. Try Forgemaster Dravic in the Guildhall.

opening.speaker: Dravic
opening.text:
Hail, Wanderer! So Ozmand sent you at last! Gorlak's Ogres have seized the Old Smelter on Slag Ridge, with our whole furnace crew shut inside!

Will you go up there and get them out? The Guild has a fat bounty on Gorlak's head, dead or alive, and not a forge in Varnok will light again till the Smelter is ours!

reminder.speaker: Dravic
reminder.text: Gorlak's hammer is a brute of a weapon and will even split a good steel shield at one blow.

journal.text: Climb Slag Ridge to the Old Smelter and free the furnace crew.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Hobbe the carter points the player to Mayor Quillon in the Town Hall, who sends him to drive Vosk out of the watchtower on Rook Hill.

herald.speaker: Hobbe
herald.text: My cart... gone... ask Mayor Quillon.

opening.speaker: Mayor Quillon
opening.text:
Adventurer! So Pellam has sent you at last! You must hurry up Rook Hill and drive Vosk out of the old watchtower! His bandits came down on the crossroads and dragged off every carter they could catch, and now they sit up there waiting on ransom. Unfortunately, while that tower is his, the watch keeps our north gate shut and won't open it to anyone without my seal. Here, take it. Between you and me, Vosk never paid the town for that cart of his either.

Well? Why are you still standing about? Does nobody listen to me?

reminder.speaker: Mayor Quillon
reminder.text:
Why are you still in my hall? Those carters won't last much longer up there!

Go! Vosk won't wait on you!

journal.text: Drive Vosk's bandits out of the old watchtower on Rook Hill.

variants.specifics: Belvik: Orrick points the player to Mayor Pellandor in the Town Hall, who sends him to drive the Ogres out of the old watchtower of Krell and open the north road.

herald.speaker: Orrick
herald.text: Go on ahead, Wanderer. Mayor Pellandor at the Town Hall will know what to do with these filthy brutes.

opening.speaker: Mayor Pellandor
opening.text:
Oh... at last! I can't keep this village calm much longer!

The Ogres... they've shut... they've shut the north road. The harvest carts can't get out, and Ferrigan expects them any day! I think the brutes are dug in at the old watchtower of Krell.

Will you... will you drive them out of there?

reminder.speaker: Mayor Pellandor
reminder.text: The north road runs straight up to the tower, you won't miss it.

journal.text: Find the watchtower of Krell and drive out the Ogres.
